display.name: WhatsApp (web)
display.description: WhatsApp chats, messages, contacts and groups, read from the signed-in WhatsApp Web page's own local stores.

refresh_policy.rationale: Collection reads the page's own local stores inside the owner's signed-in tab. It sends no request of its own except one on-demand history request per chat that says more messages remain on the phone; the owner starts every run and no run happens in the background. A live session refreshes without a prompt; the first run and an expired session need the owner to sign in through the browser handoff.

public_listing.rationale: First version: chats, messages, contacts and groups read from the WhatsApp Web client's own in-page stores. Never reads or emits media keys, encrypted blobs, or anything from the signal-storage / wawc_db_enc databases.

streams.name: chats
streams.description: Every chat the signed-in account has, from the page's own chat collection.

display.label: Your WhatsApp chats
display.detail: Chat kind (user, group or other), title, last activity, archive, pin, mute, unread and read-only state, and whether more messages remain on the phone.

kind.description: What the chat is, from the id's server part.

last_activity_at.description: The time of the chat's last message.

archived.description: True when the chat is archived.

pinned.description: True when the chat is pinned.

muted.description: True when the source holds a mute for the chat: muted with no end, or muted until muted_until. It is not compared with the run's clock; whether a timed mute is still in force is muted_until against the reader's clock.

muted_until.description: The time the chat's mute ends, as the source holds it (it can be in the past); null when no mute is set or the mute has no end.

unread_count.description: How many unread messages the chat has.

read_only.description: True when the chat cannot accept new messages (e.g. a closed group).

history_state.description: The chat's end-of-history-transfer state, named as the app's own module names it.

streams.name: messages
streams.description: Every message of every chat, read from the page's local message store with one on-demand history request per chat that says more messages remain on the phone.

display.label: Your WhatsApp messages
display.detail: Message text or caption, who sent it, when, whether it was forwarded or starred, media metadata, calls, polls and locations.

chat_id.description: The chat the message belongs to.

from_me.description: True when the signed-in account wrote the message.

author.description: The id of who wrote the message: in a group, the participant (the owner's own id for the owner's messages); in a one-to-one chat, the owner's own id when from_me, else the chat peer's id. Null only when the page does not say.

type.description: The message's own type, e.g. chat, image, video, call_log, poll.

subtype.description: The message's own subtype when it has one.

text.description: The message's body for a chat message, or its caption for media.

quoted_id.description: The id of the message this one quotes, null when it quotes nothing.

is_forwarded.description: True when the message was forwarded.

starred.description: True when the message is starred.

media_mimetype.description: The media's mimetype, null for a non-media message.

media_duration.description: For audio, voice-note and video messages, the media's duration in seconds; null for other types, whose duration value has no known unit.

call_log.description: For a call message, the call's outcome.

call_duration.description: For a call message, how long the call lasted in seconds.

poll_name.description: For a poll message, the poll's name.

location_lat.description: For a location message, the latitude.

location_lng.description: For a location message, the longitude.

streams.name: contacts
streams.description: Only contacts that appear in the user's chats or groups.

display.label: Your WhatsApp contacts
display.detail: Contact name, short name, push name, and business identity when one is known.

name.description: The contact's full name, as the address book or the app has it.

push_name.description: The name the contact set for themselves.

is_business.description: True when the contact is a business account.

streams.name: groups
streams.description: The group metadata of every group chat: subject, when it was created, its owner and the participants with their admin status.

display.label: Your WhatsApp groups
display.detail: Group subject, creation time, owner, and the participants with their admin and super-admin status.

created_at.description: The time the group was created.

participants.description: The group's participants, with their admin and super-admin status.

is_admin.description: True when the participant is a group admin.

is_super_admin.description: True when the participant is the group's super admin.

reason_display_messages.scope_not_supported: WhatsApp messages can only be imported together with their chats. Select both to import your messages.

pageshim.login_message: Sign in to WhatsApp Web, then return here.
